sensors.name: left light sensor LLIGHT (light from above)

control_flow: followInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 % (dark), then the line tracker below 90 % curves left, above 90 % curves right, exactly 90 % goes to avoidWalls; if not dark, goes to avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if dark, turns away from a LEFT or RIGHT obstacle, else calls driveInTheDark; if not dark, calls driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if dark, drives forward at 30 %; if not dark, calls stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stops; else calls followLine.
followLine: seen black, curves left (10/40); not black, curves right (40/10).

likely_intent.description: In the dark, follow a black line when one is under the robot, otherwise drive straight; in the light, follow the line.
